configurePresets.name: cuda-base
configurePresets.description: CUDA-specific settings, isolated from 'base' so a non-CUDA repo can drop this preset and the inherits reference below with no other changes.

buildPresets.name: x64-debug
buildPresets.description: Maps each build preset 1:1 to the configure preset of the same name, so callers (CI, build.ps1, local builds) run 'cmake --build --preset <name>' instead of hardcoding 'cmake --build build/<name>'. Without this, binaryDir's naming convention would be duplicated in every caller instead of living only in configurePresets - the exact drift this file exists to prevent.

buildPresets.name: x64-release
buildPresets.description: See 'x64-debug' build preset for the rationale.
